hook: Your next step in Iceland can take you between two continents.
title: Walk Between Two Continents In Iceland
description:
At Thingvellir National Park in Iceland, the North American and Eurasian tectonic plates are pulling apart, and the rift is visible on the ground. You can walk through the gap between them.

#Shorts #Iceland #Geography
comment_prompt: Would you walk this rift? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your next step in Iceland can cross two continents.
scenes.headline: BETWEEN TWO PLATES

scenes.narration: Here, the North American plate meets the Eurasian plate.
scenes.headline: AMERICA MEETS EURASIA

scenes.narration: That split is a visible rift in the ground.
scenes.headline: THE RIFT IS VISIBLE

scenes.narration: And there is a path you can walk through it.
scenes.headline: YOU CAN WALK IT

scenes.narration: One wall is North America, the other Eurasia.
scenes.headline: TWO CONTINENT WALLS

scenes.narration: So yes, you can stand between continents.
scenes.headline: BETWEEN CONTINENTS
